title: Alarm False-Alarm Rate
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=alarm:event action=trigger
| stats sum(eval(if(outcome="false",1,0))) as false_alarms, count as triggers by zone
| eval false_pct=round(100*false_alarms/triggers,1)
| sort - false_pct
description: Measures how often each alarm zone triggers falsely so you can fix the sensor that keeps crying wolf.
value: False alarms erode trust and risk fines; pinpointing the worst zone lets you reposition or adjust a single problem sensor.
implementation: Tag alarm triggers with their outcome; schedule monthly and rank zones by false-alarm rate.
visualization: Bar chart of false-alarm rate by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It measures which alarm sensors keep going off for no reason, so you can fix the troublesome one.
